card.name: Space before mg/kg dose numbers
card.fires_on: The blank space token right before a number in an antibody-drug dosing instruction, such as KADCYLA or ENHERTU, either a mg/kg amount or a number of weeks.

modes.label: Before interval
modes.description: Space after 'every' or 'for' just before a number of weeks.

modes.label: Before dose amount
modes.description: Space just before a mg/kg dose number after the drug name or 'is'.

card.plain: It marks the gap just before a dose amount or number of weeks in cancer infusion dosing lines.
